title: Profile image upload route has no linked request-level coverage
reasoning: The owned feature is the public route wiring for `profile/image-upload/`, but the included tests exercise Armenian/Bible helpers, devotional APIs, fast views, email behavior, and feast admin icon endpoints. None of the provided tests makes a request to `/hub/profile/image-upload/`, reverses `profile-image-upload`, or verifies expected authentication/upload behavior, so route regressions such as accidental removal, wrong URL name, or incompatible request handling would not be caught by the linked suite.
recommendation: Add focused request-level tests for the `profile-image-upload` URL that cover URL reversing, unauthenticated access, authenticated upload success, and invalid/missing file responses according to the view contract.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The linked tests are associated with other hub features and do not reference the `profile-image-upload` route or `ProfileImageUploadView`.
suggestedRegressionTest: Use DRF/Django test client to `reverse('profile-image-upload')`, assert the resolved path is `/hub/profile/image-upload/` under the project include prefix, then exercise authenticated multipart upload and key failure cases.
minimumFixScope: Add tests for the profile image upload route and view behavior; no production code change is implied by the provided evidence.
